faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers.
faq.a1: Yes! The free tier includes unlimited decks and cards, spaced repetition, translations, import/export, and community decks — with no time limit. Pro and Premium plans add AI-powered features and priority support.
faq.a2: Spaced repetition is a scientifically-proven learning technique that shows you information at increasing intervals. Our SM-2 algorithm calculates the optimal time to review each card, so you study efficiently and retain more.
faq.q3: Can I use it on mobile?
faq.a3: Yes! Esli is a fully responsive web app that works great on any device — phone, tablet, or desktop. Just open it in your browser, no app store download needed.
faq.q4: How does AI card generation work?
faq.a4: Simply describe a topic (like "Spanish vocabulary for travel" or "JavaScript array methods") and our AI generates high-quality flashcards instantly. You can also upload a PDF and AI will extract key concepts into cards.
faq.a5: Yes! Our browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge lets you right-click any text on the web to instantly create a flashcard. It's the fastest way to save things you want to remember.
faq.q6: Can I study without creating an account?
faq.a6: Absolutely. Guest mode lets you create decks and study with full spaced repetition — all stored locally in your browser. Create an account anytime to sync across devices and unlock AI features.
